name: dbg-panel-mobile-fit
description: Admin debug console panel must fit within the mobile viewport (no horizontal overflow). Regression test for the fixed width:400 panel overflowing narrow screens. Assertion works by injecting #fit-pass only when the measurement is clean; the following waitFor times out (hard fail) if it is absent.

steps._comment: Deterministic start: console closed, no markers left from a prior run
u/bob is FTUE; the coach tooltip overlays and swallows the DBG toggle
Open only if not already open, so the test is re-runnable
Long unbroken token exercises the overflowWrap fix in the input row

steps.expression: (() => { const p=document.querySelector('[data-testid="debug-panel"]'); const r=p.getBoundingClientRect(); const de=document.documentElement; const vw=de.clientWidth; const overflowRight=Math.round(r.right-vw); const docOverflow=de.scrollWidth-de.clientWidth; const ok = overflowRight<=0 && docOverflow<=0 && r.width>120; const d=document.createElement('div'); d.id = ok?'fit-pass':'fit-fail'; d.style.cssText='position:fixed;width:1px;height:1px;left:0;top:0;opacity:0.01'; document.body.appendChild(d); return JSON.stringify({vw,panelW:Math.round(r.width),panelLeft:Math.round(r.left),panelRight:Math.round(r.right),overflowRight,docScrollW:de.scrollWidth,docClientW:de.clientWidth,docOverflow,verdict:ok?'PASS':'FAIL'}); })()
steps._comment: Measure panel vs viewport and inject the verdict marker element
HARD ASSERTION: times out and fails the run if the panel overflowed
